steps.title: Goal
steps.content: Help the farmer harvest a crop!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.content: From the {Farm} category, add a {harvest row (1) column (1)} block and place it below all other blocks inside the {begin} block.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.content: Inside the {harvest row (1) column (1)} block, change the number for the column from 1 to 2 so that it is the same as in the plant and water blocks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.content: Press the {Run All Days} button. Has 1 crop been harvested? Great job!
